text: The Honda CLR CityFly was launched in 1998 as a dual-purpose motorcycle and is equipped with a 49–124 cc (3.0–7.6 cu in) SOHC single-cylinder engine. It does not share its engine with the Honda CG but instead uses the engine from the Honda XLR offroad motorcycle. The CLR CityFly was discontinued in 2003. While originally marketed as a dual-purpose vehicle, it gained greater recognition for use in city and town environments, primarily because of its engine's limited power. The motorcycle received mostly favorable reviews when it was first released.
